name: plugin-builder
description: Scaffold Claude Code + OpenAI Codex plugins from a single UnifiedSpec.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold and validate Claude Code plus Codex plugins from one spec.
interface.longDescription: Plugin Builder creates dual-target Claude Code and OpenAI Codex plugin trees from a single UnifiedSpec, validates generated plugins, and patches marketplace catalogs.
capabilities: Create hybrid Claude Code and Codex plugin scaffolds
Validate manifests, file structure, cross-references, dry-runs, and marketplace catalogs
Publish plugin entries to Claude and Codex marketplace catalogs
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a new plugin for both Claude Code and Codex
